0022600143.text: The LA Clippers (1-2, 9th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) host the Los Angeles Lakers (3-1, 5th in the West, 1st in the Pacific), who enter on a one-game losing streak. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Jordan Miller, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura, and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero and Cameron Carr. This season the Clippers trail the Lakers 0-1 after losing 125-117 in Los Angeles on October 23, and the two teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
